subject: english
question: The word "up skilling" means:

options.text: Improving skills to match new demands

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Improving skills to match new demands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"up skilling"** refers to:

 
 
• Improving and enhancing one's existing skills to meet new requirements or demands in a particular field or industry. (किसी क्षेत्र या उद्योग में नई आवश्यकताओं या मांगों को पूरा करने के लिए अपने मौजूदा कौशल को सुधारना और बढ़ाना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The company offers training programs to help employees with up skilling for advanced technical roles.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score.

Therefore, the term “up skilling” in the given context means: **Improving skills to match new demands**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Reducing skills** (कौशल को कम करना): To make one's abilities or knowledge less effective or competent.

 
 
• **Example:** Due to lack of practice, she found her language skills reducing over time.
 
 
 
• **Losing knowledge** (ज्ञान खोना): Forgetting or becoming unable to recall previously learned information.
 
 
• **Example:** After years of inactivity in the field, he felt he was losing knowledge related to programming.
 
 
 
• **Quitting studies** (अध्ययन छोड़ना): To stop one's education or academic pursuits.
 
 
• **Example:** Due to personal reasons, she considered quitting studies and starting work immediately.
 
 

49:Td1f,
The correct answer is '**Option 3 (Too many graduates and out-dated education)**'.
